title: Add Skill and LM Wiki management workbench views
requirements: Authenticated WebUI views expose actual runtime Skill catalog metadata, audience scope, unavailable declarations and bounded usage counts.
Authenticated WebUI views expose actual published Wiki Markdown entities, scope filters, versions, facts, topics, slang and links without inventing pages.
Preserve the existing Kinna workbench shell and connect views to the already-bound runtime and read-only projections.
